name: Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges with Ranch (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 small and 4 mini food storage containers. (For kid-sized portions, divide sweet potato wedges and dressing into 6 portions instead of 4.)

Wash, dry, peel, and trim sweet potatoes. Cut each sweet potato in half crosswise, then each half lengthwise into 6-8 wedges, depending on size. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping every 10 minutes, until potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely, about 10 minutes.
When the sweet potatoes are cool, divide between small containers. Divide dressing between mini containers.
Cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat sweet potatoes (if desired) in the oven, air-fryer, or microwave. Dip in dressing and enjoy!
